# Environment: props, materials, HDRIs

Level props (crates, consoles, rocks), PBR textures, and HDRIs. Levels are
currently code-generated box geometry; this folder is for the art pass.

**Good CC0 sources (no attribution):**
- Textures / HDRIs — https://polyhaven.com and https://ambientcg.com
- Sci-fi props — Kenney (https://kenney.nl/assets — Space Kit, Sci-Fi RTS) and
  Quaternius Sci-Fi Essentials Kit.

Prefer `.glb` for models and `.exr`/`.hdr` for HDRIs. See `docs/ASSET_SOURCES.md`.
